description: A code-split app bundled with Parcel 2 + @afterpack/parcel-optimizer (an Optimizer, so the bundle is obfuscated IN MEMORY and never hits disk in cleartext). Proves the obfuscated Parcel bundle survives: the page renders, and the counter interaction resolves and executes a LAZILY IMPORTED, content-hashed chunk whose #private-field class was obfuscated.

build.note: `parcel build index.html --target app` emits dist/, obfuscated by @afterpack/parcel-optimizer during packaging. The seed is pinned in afterpack.json (the plugin's only config channel -- .parcelrc entries carry no inline options) and asserted to match `seed` above.

interactions.description: Clicking the counter dynamically imports a SEPARATE content-hashed chunk and runs its obfuscated #private-field class. This is the regression test for Parcel's HASH_REF content-hash placeholders: if AfterPack obfuscated the chunk URL away, this chunk would 404 and the text would never change.
